a_records.quote: [Persian] 'Under the assumptions of Theorem 3, if prod_{i=1}^n p_i >= prod_{i=1}^n p_i^* and sum_{i=1}^n lambda_i^alpha <= sum_{i=1}^n (lambda_i^*)^alpha, then for alpha > 0,  (prod_{i=1}^n p_i / prod_{i=1}^n p_i^*)^alpha = sum_{i=1}^n lambda_i^alpha / sum_{i=1}^n (lambda_i^*)^alpha  ==>  Y_{1:n} >=_cx Y*_{1:n}.'
a_records.family: independent Weibull claims with Bernoulli thinning
a_records.compared: portfolios (lambda, p) vs (lambda*, p*) in the convex order

hypotheses.text: (prod p_i / prod p_i^*)^alpha = sum lambda_i^alpha / sum (lambda_i^*)^alpha
hypotheses.formal: balancing equality that enforces E(Y_{1:n}) = E(Y*_{1:n})

conclusion.direction: Y_{1:n} >=_cx Y*_{1:n} (convex order: E(Y_{1:n}-d)_+ >= E(Y*_{1:n}-d)_+ with equal means)

a_records.quantifiers: n >= 1; alpha > 0; all d in R
a_records.ambiguity: Order denoted >=_cx (convex order with equal means per Definition 4(c)).

b_records.quote: قضیه ۵: تحت مفروضات قضیه ٣، اگر Πi=١..n pi >= Πi=١..n p*i و Σi=١..n λi^α <= Σi=١..n (λ*i)^α، آنگاه برای α > ٠، (Πi=١..n pi / Πi=١..n p*i) = (Σi=١..n λi^α / Σi=١..n (λ*i)^α)^{1/α} ⟹ Y١:n >=cx Y*١:n.
b_records.family: Weibull W(α, λ_i) with Bernoulli indicators

hypotheses.formal: equal-means calibration between the two portfolios

b_records.quantifiers: n >= 1, α > 0, d in R for the stop-loss integrals
